a.lede: The UK government has outlined plans for new powers and criminal offenses to help protect undersea cables in UK waters amid fears of Russian interference.
a.title: UK proposes 14-year prison sentences for undersea cable saboteurs amid Russian trawler threats

b.lede: Whitehall wants tougher penalties and new powers over telecoms operators as Russian activity raises alarm
b.title: UK threatens subsea cable saboteurs with 14 years behind bars
